question: The iron pillar is situated in which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron pillar:-**

 
 
• It is situated in Delhi, India.
 
• The iron pillar is a 7.21-meter-tall pillar made of wrought iron and is located in the Qutub Complex in Delhi.
 
• The pillar was built during the Gupta Empire, which ruled northern India from the 4th to the 6th century AD.
 
• The iron pillar is known for its resistance to corrosion. Despite being exposed to the elements for over 1600 years, it has not rusted or corroded significantly.
 
• The pillar has inscriptions in Sanskrit that mention the king who commissioned it, Chandragupta II. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kolkata**:-

 
 
• It is a city in eastern India and is known for its colonial architecture and cultural landmarks.
 
 
 
• **Chennai**:-
 
 
• It is a city in southern India and is known for its beaches, temples, and museums.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur:-**
 
 
• It is a city in northern India and is known for its historical forts and palaces, including the famous Hawa Mahal.
